# Requirement and prediction traceability

Requirement → assumption → implementation → test → evaluated result → claim. A result carries the class of evidence it was computed from: SATISFIED (analytical) means a calculation met the bound, not that hardware did.

## How each requirement can be closed

| How it is checked | Meaning | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| machine | Evaluated automatically from a committed artifact value. | R-C1-CLOSURE, R-C1-TRANSMISSION, R-C4-REDUCTION, R-C5-WINDOW, R-C6-KMIN, R-C6-MARGIN, R-C7-RELIABILITY, R-C8-HINGE-FOS, R-C8-MODULUS |
| test | Evaluated from an attached execution record of named automated tests. | R-C3-PROFILE, R-C3-STEP |
| human review | Needs engineering judgement; software cannot close it. | R-C2-NONBLOCKING, R-C4-SCOPE, R-C5-FORMULATION, R-C8-COMPONENT-STIFFNESS |
| physical measurement | Needs an inert physical measurement; software cannot close it. | R-C1-LOCK, R-C2-JITTER, R-C6-SPRING-RATE, R-C7-PHYSICAL |

## Prediction ledger and model-to-measurement comparison

Predicted values are frozen when registered; a later model output that differs fails `python -m evidence check` as PREDICTION DRIFT. An empty measurement is NOT MEASURED, never zero.

| ID | Quantity (condition) | Predicted | Model uncertainty | Measured | Abs. error | Rel. error | Criterion | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| PRED-C2-DELAY | delay from deploy trigger call to GPIO 33 rising edge (rocket firmware as committed; inert bench; no load on GPIO 33) | 50000 us [implementation] | not quantified | NOT MEASURED | — | — | not pre-registered | NOT MEASURED |
| PRED-C5-DRY-CG | dry centre of gravity from nose tip (OpenRocket override masses of the body tubes only; no motor) | 0.335817 m [analytical] | not quantified | NOT MEASURED | — | — | not pre-registered | NOT MEASURED |
| PRED-C6-SPRING-RATE | torsion spring rate of the supplied spring (spring as supplied, room temperature, within its rated angle) | 220 N*m/rad [specification] | not quantified | NOT MEASURED | — | — | not pre-registered | NOT MEASURED |
| PRED-C7-LOCK-FRACTION | fraction of deployments that reach and hold the lock position (simulated tolerance ranges of the C7 run record) | 1 fraction [simulated] | not quantified | NOT MEASURED | — | — | not pre-registered | NOT MEASURED |
| PRED-TLM-T-INTERVAL | interval between successive rocket DATA packets (rocket firmware as committed, MPU6050 healthy) | 50 ms [implementation] | not quantified | NOT MEASURED | — | — | not pre-registered | NOT MEASURED |

## Pre-registered experiments

Written before testing so success criteria cannot be chosen after the result. `proposed` entries were drafted and await adoption by a named human.

| ID | Experiment | Status | Registered by | Interpretation rule |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P-001 | Deploy-output timing on inert hardware | proposed | not registered by a human | Report median, maximum absolute deviation from 50,000 us, and trial count. R-C2-JITTER is satisfied only if the maximum absolute deviation over at least 1,000 trials is below 1,000 us after subtracting the instrument's stated timing uncertainty. Fewer trials: report the observation, do not evaluate the requirement. |
| P-002 | Torsion spring rate of the supplied spring | proposed | not registered by a human | Fit torque against angle over the rated range; report slope with its standard error and the hysteresis. Compare with 220 N*m/rad; the acceptance tolerance must be written here by the registering human before testing. |
| P-003 | Stationary roll-estimate drift | proposed | not registered by a human | Report the roll change over 600 s and the maximum excursion. Because no prediction exists, the result describes this unit only and sets a baseline; it cannot pass or fail. |
